root_cause.text: The SCTP subsystem fails to validate the length field of the cached peer INIT chunk header against the remaining COOKIE_ECHO payload buffer size in `sctp_unpack_cookie()`, allowing an inflated length to cause out-of-bounds reads during parameter parsing.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a bounds check in `sctp_unpack_cookie()` that rejects the packet if the cached INIT chunk header length exceeds the remaining buffer size:
